categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and modifies CI configuration to run IPC tests in the 32-bit x86 build job.
categories.rationale: Enables CI testing of IPC on 32-bit x86 where compiler ABI differences have historically caused failures. The PR description notes that 32-bit ABI issues previously affected libmultiprocess, making coverage on this architecture worthwhile rather than arbitrarily disabling IPC.
